standard_taps: IF sprite_temperature_humidity_sensor_KD30.get_temperature() > 28 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN switch_cooling_mode() NWT_Internet_Mobile_Air_Conditioner
IF sprite_temperature_humidity_sensor_KD30.get_temperature() < 22 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN switch_heating_mode() NWT_Internet_Mobile_Air_Conditioner
IF qingping_air_monitor.reading_temperature() > 28 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN switch_cooling_mode() NWT_Internet_Mobile_Air_Conditioner
IF qingping_air_monitor.reading_temperature() < 22 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN switch_heating_mode() NWT_Internet_Mobile_Air_Conditioner
IF qingping_air_monitor.reading_PM2_5() > 77 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN turn_on() xiaomi_air_purifier
IF sprite_temperature_humidity_sensor_KD30.get_humidity() > 22 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN turn_off() zhimi_humidifier
IF sprite_temperature_humidity_sensor_KD30.get_humidity() < 22 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN turn_on() zhimi_humidifier
IF qingping_air_monitor.reading_humidity() > 22 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN turn_off() zhimi_humidifier
IF qingping_air_monitor.reading_humidity() < 22 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN turn_on() zhimi_humidifier
